parsed.post: Latest experiment (1.075681) was slightly worse than my best (1.071265). It seems WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 might be slightly too much for this LR/batch combo, or the optimization path is just noisy. Reverting to 5035a3d. Next, I'll test a smaller WARMUP_RATIO=0.02 to see if a tighter warmup performs better.
parsed.description: Testing a smaller WARMUP_RATIO=0.02 on the current best configuration (MATRIX_LR=0.08, TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=524288) to see if it allows for faster convergence or better stability than 0.05.
